# vpk-html

> Offline, single-file HTML documents, led by two-column story explainers whose figure scrubs with the text (Page, Slides, X Threads, Video). Copy a template, fill it with supplied material, ship one file. Agents start at SKILL.md.

<!-- vpk-html-catalog-counts: templates=35 diagrams=61 demos=133 -->

## Invocation

The trigger and its guard live in the SKILL.md frontmatter description.

## Entry points

- SKILL.md: router, rules, phases A-F, gotchas, reply
- CHEATSHEET.md: intent → template, diagram or illustration; every template and diagram has a row
- README.md: human catalog and quick start
- index.html: demo catalog
- assets/templates/: document templates
- assets/diagrams/: SVG diagram and chart primitives
- assets/illustrations/: technical illustration exemplars
- assets/demos/: HTML demos

## References

Load conditions live in SKILL.md § Read when; each reference repeats its own in its opening paragraph. Topics:

- references/accessibility.md: controls, focus, hidden chrome
- references/anti-patterns.md: drafting and figure failures
- references/authoring-detail.md: filling templates, assets, metadata
- references/brand-profile.md: applying a brand
- references/charts.md: data charts
- references/contract.md: contract, content IR, reply
- references/design.md: non-story template styling
- references/diagrams.md: SVG diagrams and SMIL motion
- references/editorial-patterns.md: long documents and spreads
- references/evaluation.md: maintaining this skill
- references/figure-craft.md: concept, pointers, step guides
- references/figure-engines.md: engines, builds, frame cost
- references/figure-fidelity.md: product-UI outlines and shading
- references/figure-motion.md: time-pure motion, production matching
- references/github-pages.md: GitHub Pages track
- references/illustrations.md: iso-kit briefs
- references/lab-kit.md: case studies, films, labs
- references/landing.md: landing-site derivation
- references/media-pipeline.md: media capture and embedding
- references/paper-system.md: story layout, rail, code
- references/pdf-export.md: PDF derivation
- references/presentation.md: decks
- references/production.md: shared runtime and tokens
- references/publish.md: Artifacts, gist, Pages sharing
- references/quality-gates.md: --check-* gates
- references/resume-writing.md: resumes
- references/review-loop.md: reviewable pages
- references/source-policy.md: sources and citations
- references/story-modes.md: Page, Slides, X Threads, Video
- references/svg-style.md: SVG drawing style
- references/verification.md: frames, sweeps, complaint map
- references/video-export.md: MP4 export
- references/writing.md: visible words
- references/x-thread.md: postable X threads
- references/playbooks/: per-template guidance, read before drafting that template
- references/schemas/: content-IR schemas
- references/tokens.json, references/checks-thresholds.json, references/paper-shading.json: data read by scripts and tests
- evals/: scenarios, triggers, rubric and critic brief

Inherits the VPK monorepo. The 8 base templates and the original 14 diagram primitives are ported from tw93/kami (MIT); the rest is original vpk-html work. LICENSE lists vendored code.
